title: GIVE HEED TO MY WORDS O LORD

lines.text: Give heed to my words, O Lord,
Hearken unto the voice of my cry,
For Lord unto Thee will I pray.
My voice shall Thou hear in the morning.
O Lord in the morning will I direct my prayer
Unto Thee, and will look up ! (repeat)

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Give heed to my words, O Lord,
Consider my meditation.
Hearken unto the voice of my cry,
My King and my God,
For Lord unto Thee will I pray.
My voice shall Thou hear in the morning.
O Lord in the morning will I direct my prayer
Unto Thee, and will look up ! (repeat)
